definitions.full: H5000. naveh נָאוֶה adjective comely, seemly ; — ׳נ masculine Song 2:14 3 t.; feminine נָאוָה Psa 33:1 4 t., נָוָה Jer 6:2 ; — 1 comely, beautiful , of woman Song 1:5 ; 6:4 (|| יָפָה ) of face 2:14 ( מַרְאֶה ) so נָוָה Jer 6:2 (figurative of Jerusalem; || מְעֻנָּגָה ); of mouth Song 4:3 (|| שְׂפָתוֺת ). 2 seemly , of praise תְּהִלָּה Psa 33:1 ; 147:1 ; subject שְׂפַתיֶֿתֶר Prov 17:7 (compare Song 4:3 ); תַּעֲנוּג Cant 19:10; כָּבוֺד Cant 26:1. So also Psa 93:5 Masora (anomalous feminine) see [ נאה ] above נְאוֺת see II. [ נָוָה ] below II. נוה . נאם √ of following; compare groan, sigh ; perhaps also Late Hebrew נוּם speak ).
